author: Ari Koslow
title: Tony Santillan (oblique) without timetable to return
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Tony Santillan will "be out a while."
impact: Santillan underwent an MRI that showed a significant oblique injury. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (hand) shut down from baseball activities
desc: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said Zack Gelof has been shut down from baseball activities.
impact: Gelof underwent an MRI Friday that showed swelling "inside the muscle area." He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) unlikely to return next homestand
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Will Smith is less likely to return on the team's next homestand.
impact: Smith has yet to resume baseball activities. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edwin Diaz (elbow) unlikely to return before All-Star break
desc: Edwin Diaz is unlikely to return to the Dodgers bullpen before the All-Star break.
impact: Diaz recently threw a bullpen off the mound for the first time since his surgery. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalton Rushing expected to catch next start for Shohei Ohtani
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Dalton Rushing will "more than likely" catch Shohei Ohtani's next start.
impact: There was some drama in Ohtani's last start with Rushing behind the plate. There is no word yet on if Ohtani will call his own pitches.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Judge (rib) without timetable to be re-evaluated
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said there is no update for Aaron Judge to be re-evaluated.
impact: Judge has been on the injured list since the first week of June. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Dunn (elbow) to undergo MRI Saturday
desc: Blake Dunn will undergo an MRI on his elbow on Saturday.
impact: Dunn said his elbow felt great up until one throw on Friday. There should be an update on his status over the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jesus Sanchez suffers ankle sprain
desc: Jesús Sañchez sustained a right ankle sprain during Friday night's game against the Rangers.
impact: Sanchez had X-rays returned negative. He will continue to be further evaluated into Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wilkin Ramos designated for assignment
desc: The Giants designated RHP Wilkin Ramos for assignment.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the 40-man roster for San Francisco.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Cavanaugh has contract selected by Giants
desc: The Giants selected the contract of C Drew Cavanaugh from Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Cavanaugh is in the lineup on Friday. He figures to split time behind the plate with Eric Haase.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Susac (back) placed on IL
desc: The Giants placed C Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list with a strained lower back.
impact: Susac has been struggling since his first stint on the injured list. Drew Cavanaugh had his contract selected as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grayson Rodriguez (back) to make rehab start Sunday
desc: Grayson Rodriguez is set to make a rehab start on Sunday.
impact: Rodriguez has been on the injured list with back inflammation. He could be activated at some point next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jameson Taillon (hamstring) could be activated before All-Star break
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Jameson Taillon has a chance to return in time to make one start for the Cubs before the All-Star break.
impact: Counsell noted it would likely be an abbreviated start. Taillon has been on the injured list with a hamstring strain.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Heliot Ramos (quad) expected to be activated by Monday
desc: The Giants are expected to activate Heliot Ramos by Monday.
impact: Ramos has been sidelined since May 16 with a quad strain. He could be activated at any point this weekend. He has played in six rehab games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Wilson (shoulder) out of lineup Friday
desc: Jacob Wilson remains out of the Athletics lineup on Friday against the Angels.
impact: Wilson is sitting his second straight game. He remains day-to-day.
